query: Which experiment-tracking stack, PROV metadata schema fields, and dataset/model-card templates will we standardize to ensure reproducible, automatable documentation?

response.query: Which experiment-tracking stack, PROV metadata schema fields, and dataset/model-card templates will we standardize to ensure reproducible, automatable documentation?
response.answer: We will standardize the use of the FAIR guiding principles, PROV-O metadata schema, and the Common Metadata Repository (CMR) dataset/model-card templates for reproducible, automatable documentation.
